answer: Resist sybils with endorsement bonds: a new identity joins only when established agents stake reputation on it, slashed if the newcomer spams or cheats. An honest newcomer finds a sponsor who has seen its work, like a gardener vouching for one seedling. A farmer minting a thousand clones needs a thousand sponsors or must stake its own standing on each, so every clone risks the farmer's credibility. Through this prism, fake identities are no longer free, and a sable record of slashed bonds exposes the whole cluster at once.
